7858.title: Sender identity depends on cached thread metadata
7858.rootCauseOneLine: Sender titles are resolved only from existing client caches; a hidden uncached sender has no detail fetch and falls back to Agent.
7858.proposedFix: Resolve missing sender metadata through the existing per-thread detail path with request deduplication and unavailable-sender fallback. Split the public plugin decoration and paste-provenance design requests into separate work.
7858.caveats: Two clean component-level runs reproduce the title defect. Other feature requests were source-inspected only. Browser screenshot unavailable because Chrome/Chromium is absent. No PR: the complete bundle requires public API/schema changes and product decisions excluded by the simple-fix rules.
